name: Alfredo
steps: Open bag; squeeze to get all product out.
Pour alfredo into lined amber 1/6 pans.
Lid + day dot on each pan; place in cooler.

name: Asian Slaw
steps: Mix mayo and sesame ginger until smooth.
Add mixture to slaw mix; stir well.
Label and refrigerate. Transfer to squeeze bottle for service.

name: Bell Peppers
steps: Rinse peppers thoroughly.
Halve top-to-bottom; remove core, seeds, membrane.
Quarter and dice skin-side-up in the dicer.
Portion into shallow 1/6 pan with lid; day dot; cooler.

name: Blue Cheese Crumbles
steps: Portion 2 oz into black togo ramekins with lids.
Place portions in 1/3 pan with lid; day dot; cooler.

name: Celery
steps: Cut ends off; wash well.
Cut into 4" pieces; halve wide stalks.
Day dot each pan; cooler.

name: Cheese Sauce
steps: Open bag; work product out.
Pour into lined amber 1/6 pans.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Chili
steps: Sauté onions, peppers, tomatoes, bacon in margarine until tender; move to pot.
Brown beef on flat top with Tony's; strain grease; add to pot.
Add chili seasoning + ketchup; mix well.
Add water + canned tomatoes; boil, then simmer 30 min.
Pour into lined 1/6 pans; ice bath, stirring every 10–15 min.
Cover, date, label; walk-in.

name: Egg Rolls
steps: Layer frozen eggrolls in 1/3 pan with deli wrap between; lid.
Day dot; cooler.

name: Garlic Parmesan Sauce
steps: Mix both in stainless bowl.
Store in 1/6 pan or 2 oz ramekins with lids.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Gravy
steps: Open can; pour into lined amber 1/6 pans; scrape can.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Kid Mac
steps: Portion equally into 2 lined 1/6 pans.
Low usage: scoop 6 oz portions into togo squats with lids.
Label, date; cooler.

name: Burger Lettuce
steps: Core, halve; BLUE Saber King shredder (1/4" shreds).
Ice bath in drain-insert lexan; rinse; drain.
Bag, squeeze air out, tie; day dot; cooler.

name: Iceberg Lettuce (chopped)
steps: Core, halve; GREEN Saber King chopper (1"×1").
Ice bath; rinse; drain.
Bag, tie, day dot; cooler.

name: Romaine Lettuce (chopped)
steps: Core, halve; GREEN Saber King chopper (1"×1").
Ice bath; rinse; drain.
Bag, tie, day dot; cooler.

name: Salad Mix
steps: Prep iceberg + romaine per their cards.
Mix in deep lexan; add spring mix; toss well.
Bag, tie, day dot; cooler.

name: Mahi Mahi
steps: Unpack into 1/3 pan with drip, max 2 layers.
Saran wrap pressed tight to keep air out.
Day dot; cooler.

name: Marinara
steps: Open can; pour into lined amber 1/6 pans; scrape can.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Open bag; pour into lined amber 1/6 pans; squeeze bag.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Diced Onions
steps: Slice ends, peel outer layer; quarter.
ORANGE Saber King blade, dice skin-side-up.
Into 1/6 pan with lid; day dot; cooler.

name: Parmesan Cheese
steps: Portion 1 oz into black togo ramekins with lids.
Place in 1/3 pan with lid; day dot; cooler.

name: New Pasta
steps: Thaw frozen pasta (cooks best thawed).
Portion to 7 oz; place in 1/3 pan.
Label, date; cooler.

name: Pickles
steps: Drain in colander.
Portion 4 oz into portion bags; roll tight.
Place in 1/3 pan with lid; day dot; cooler.

name: Pico de Gallo
steps: Mix all in stainless bowl.
Store in plastic 1/6 pan; lid + day dot; cooler.
off: Off the menu — Aug 2026 rollout. Where a build called for it: diced tomatoes & red onions.

name: Pimento Cheese
steps: Mix all in stainless bowl.
Store in line-ready pan or 1/3 cup portions.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Pow Pow Shrimp Sauce
steps: Mix in stainless bowl; scrape into 1/6 pan.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Quesadilla Meat
steps: Brown patty with onions on FLAT TOP only — never charbroiler; no leftover patties. No pickles yet.
Strain; cool; grease drips off.
Bag portion with 1 oz diced pickles (bulk: 5 oz cooked meat + onions per portion).
1/3 pan; label, date; cooler.

name: Mugshots Queso Dip
steps: Wash hands thoroughly; sanitize prep area.
On the flat top, break apart hamburger patty and cook until browned.
Once browned, drain excess grease and transfer into a sav-a-day.
Cut cheese into small cubes and place in amber 1/6 pan(s) with a liner.
Microwave the cheese 2-3 minutes.
Put the rest of the ingredients into the 1/6 pan(s) and mix.
Cover, day dot, and place in the appropriate spot in the cooler.
Served garnished with a fried whole fresh jalapeño.

name: Ranch Dressing
steps: Mix buttermilk + packets; whip in mayo until smooth.
Stage into cambro or 1/6 pans; scrape bowl.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Rotel Cheese Sauce
steps: Cut cheese into 2" cubes.
Split cubes between 2 lined pans; split rotel + liquid evenly.
Lid + day dot; cooler.

name: Blackened Shrimp
steps: 10 shrimp per portion bag; roll the bag up tightly.
Portioned shrimp into a 1/3 pan with a drip and a lid.
Day dot on the pan; cooler.

name: Pow Pow Shrimp
steps: Portion into bags at 6 oz each and roll tight.
1/3 pan with lid; day dot; FREEZER.

name: Shrooms
steps: Rinse thoroughly.
Portion 4 oz into portion bags.
Back into case box.

name: Sriracha Mayo
steps: Whisk all together.
Covered cambro or 1/6 pan; label; refrigerate.
Squeeze bottle for service.

name: Diced Tomatoes
steps: Dice ends skin-side-up in dicer (ORANGE blade if whole).
1/6 pan with drip + lid; day dot; cooler.

name: Sliced Tomatoes
steps: Wash; core with tomato corer.
RED Saber King to slice.
Stack usable slices in pan w/ drip + lid; ends → diced tomatoes.
Day dot; cooler.

name: Turkey
steps: Weigh 6 oz portions into bags; roll tight.
Shallow 1/3 pan with drip + lid; day dot; cooler.

name: Veggie Mix
steps: Wash produce; slice squash + zucchini 1/4".
Trim onion, quarter, slice 1/4"; save center for diced prep.
Portion bags, tight; pan with lid; date; cooler.

name: Mozzarella Wedges
steps: Mix crumbs + parsley in hotel pan; mix breading + buttermilk into batter.
Slice mozzarella 1/4"; cut diagonally into 4 triangles per slice.
Batter, then coat in crumb mix.
Layer in 8 qt container with deli paper between layers.
Lid + day dot; FREEZER.

name: Pepperjack Cheese Wedges
steps: Mix crumbs + parsley; mix breading + buttermilk into batter.
Slice 1/4"; cut into 4 equal squares per slice.
Batter, then coat.
Layer with deli paper; lid + day dot; FREEZER.

name: Blanched Wings
steps: Rinse thawed wings in lexan drip.
Fry 5 min (25/large basket, 15/small); timer.
Sheet trays, single layer; wrap pan; speed rack in freezer.
30 min timer — pull at 40°F; DO NOT freeze (manager involved).
Cooler until portioned. Cook 5 more min for service.

name: Frozen Margarita Bulk
steps: Dissolve sour mix in water in large cambro.
Add remaining items; mix well.
Add to frozen beverage machine — ready in ~30 min.
Serve in 10 oz or 22 oz mug with salted rim.

name: Frozen Tropical 'Rita Bulk
steps: Dissolve sour mix in water in large cambro.
Add remaining items; mix well.
Frozen beverage machine — ready in ~30 min.
Sugar mug rim (10/22 oz), add strawberry puree, frozen margarita on top.

name: Frozen Strawberry Margarita
steps: Pour daiquiri mix in tin; add frozen margarita.
Pour tin-to-tin twice.
Frozen mug with sugar rim; lime wedge garnish.

name: Firecracker Popper Dog
steps: Spread popper mixture evenly on right inside half of bun.
Grilled hot dog in.
6 fried jalapeño slices on the cream cheese.
Sprinkle 2 chopped bacon slices on top.
Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Classic Dog
steps: Grilled dog in toasted bun.
Drizzle ketchup + mustard; 1 Tbsp red onion.
1 oz pickle relish on the side.
Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Chicago-ish Freedom Dog
steps: Layer left in order: mustard, pickles, onion, tomatoes.
Tuck pickle spear along the right of the dog.
Sport peppers on top; sprinkle celery salt.
Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Southern Dog
steps: Build heated pimento cheese portion onto dog.
4 fried pickles on top.
Sprinkle 1 chopped bacon slice over pickles.
Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Chili Dog
steps: Grilled hot dog in the bun.
Topped with chili, rotel cheese and fried jalapeños.
Built from the printed menu — no build sheet yet, confirm portions with your manager.

name: The Colony Classic
steps: Guest picks one entrée from the list.
Fried Chicken Salad: red onion, tomatoes, cheese, croutons, house-made ranch.

name: The Freedom Feast
steps: Any two single smashburgers.
Two beer-battered fries.
One Firecracker Bites appetizer — guest picks from the bites list.

name: Classic Smash
steps: Double-stacked patties, beer-battered fries.
off: Summer 2026 LTO — ended; the live build is Single Classic Smash

name: Firecracker Bites
steps: Guest picks ONE Firecracker Bite — happy hour portion, $3 with any entrée purchase.
Ring one per entrée; full builds live under SmashBurger LTO Builds (Firecracker Boneless Wangs, Firecracker Wedges).

name: Southern Key Lime Pie Rita
steps: Combine frozen rita, soft serve shake, and tequila in mixing tin; spindle mix 5 seconds.
Pour into 16 oz pint glass rimmed with graham cracker crumbs.
Top with whipped cream + 1 Tbsp graham crumbs; garnish lime wedge and cherry.

name: Rocket Pop Rita
steps: Combine frozen rita, shake, tequila, and blue curaçao in mixing tin; spindle mix 5 seconds.
Pour into 16 oz pint glass rimmed with red/white/blue sugar.
Top with strawberry puree + whipped cream; sprinkle sugars; garnish cherry.

name: Rocket Pop Shake
steps: Combine soft serve shake and blue curaçao in mixing tin; spindle mix 5 seconds.
Pour into 10 oz mug rimmed with red/white/blue sugar.
Top with strawberry puree + whipped cream; sprinkle sugars; garnish cherry.

name: Kentucky Buck
steps: Fill a 16 oz pint glass with ice; add the Elijah Craig and peach schnapps.
Squeeze the lemon wedges over the ice and drop them in.
Cap with a mixing tin and shake well.
Remove the tin, add the ginger beer, stir with a bar spoon.
Garnish with a lemon wedge. Pairs with the Southern Smash.

name: Strawberry Lemon Twist
steps: Fill a 16 oz pint glass with ice; add the vodka and strawberry puree.
Squeeze the 2 lemon wedges over the ice and drop them in.
Top with Sprite. DO NOT shake — stir with a bar spoon.
Garnish with a lemon twist. Pairs with the Savell Smash.

name: Texas Ranch Water
steps: Rim a 16 oz pint glass with Tajín and fill with ice.
Squeeze 1 lime wedge over the ice; add the Lunazul.
Top with 6 oz Topo Chico; add the optional mixer and stir with a bar spoon.
Garnish with a lime wedge. Pairs with the Texan Smash.

name: Middleberger
steps: Dress bottom bun: mayo & mustard, red onion, pickles, lettuce, tomato.
Beef patty on top.
2 packets ketchup with every order of fries.

name: Pato
steps: Mayo & mustard on the bottom bun.
Red onion, pickles, lettuce, tomato, then the patty.

name: Stu
steps: Dress bottom bun.
Patty, then 2 oz mushrooms and a slice of swiss.

name: Gamble
steps: Sour cream on the bottom bun, then jalapeños and lettuce.
Patty, then 2 oz chili and 2 oz rotel on top.

name: McDowell
steps: Ranch on bottom bun, onion, lettuce, tomato.
Patty, bacon, cheddar.

name: Savell
steps: Dress the bottom bun.
Patty and bacon on top.

name: Anthony's Peanut Butter Burger
steps: 1 Tbsp peanut butter on the bottom bun.
Beef patty on top.
2 slices of bacon on the patty.

name: Steak Burger
steps: Dress bottom bun.
Patty with philly set, sautéed onions & peppers, swiss.

name: A1 Sauce Burger
steps: Comeback, lettuce, tomato on bottom bun.
Patty, A1, bacon, cheddar on top.

name: Comeback Burger
steps: Comeback on bottom bun, onion, lettuce, tomato.
Patty, bacon, pepperjack, onion ring on top.

name: Garlic Parm Burger
steps: Mayo on bottom bun.
Patty, garlic parm, bacon, shrooms, O-strings.

name: Mac & Cheese Burger
steps: Patty between two grilled cheeses.
Top with bacon and mac & cheese.
Do not cut.

name: Mugshot Burger
steps: Stack all three dressed patties.
Skewer with onion ring and fried pickles.
NOT available for carry-out.

name: Patty Melt
steps: Comeback on sourdough.
Patty, sautéed onions, both cheeses.
Do not cut.

name: Southern Burger
steps: Lettuce + tomato on bottom bun.
Patty, bacon, melted pimento, fried pickles.

name: Texan Burger
steps: Dress bottom bun.
Patty, pepperjack, O-strings, fried jalapeños.

name: Big Kahuna
steps: Lettuce + tomato on bottom bun.
Patty, bacon, grilled pineapple, teriyaki.

name: Hicks
ing: chopped & grilled w/ 1 oz red onions
steps: Dress bottom bun.
Chop and grill philly meat with onions; top with swiss.

name: Philly
ing: w/ 1 oz red onions + 1 oz bell peppers
steps: Dress bottom bun.
Grill philly set with onions & peppers; top with swiss.

name: Southwest Philly
steps: Comeback + lettuce on bottom bun.
Philly set, rotel, diced tomatoes & red onions on top.
off: OG — on request. No pico: diced tomatoes & red onions

name: Callie's Mahi
steps: Comeback, lettuce, tomato on bottom bun.
Blackened mahi on top. No cheese.

name: Turkey Burger
steps: Dress bottom bun; turkey patty with american cheese on top.
off: Off the menu — the patty is still available as a protein

name: Briscoe
steps: Dress the bottom bun: 1 Tbsp ranch, 1/3 cup lettuce, 1 slice of tomato.
Using a brined chicken breast, follow the chicken tender breading process.
Fry 6 minutes; pull and drain the grease in a Sav a Day.
Toss the fried breast in wing sauce; swiss cheese on top.

name: Inferno Wrap
steps: Mic tortilla 15 sec; build.
Grill cheese-side down 30 sec each side.
Cut diagonally and shingle.

name: Philly Wrap
steps: Mic tortilla 15 sec; build.
Grill 30 sec each side; cut and shingle.

name: Teriyaki Wrap
steps: Mic tortilla 15 sec; build.
Grill 30 sec each side; cut and shingle.

name: Caitlin's Cajun
steps: Dress bottom bun.
Blackened breast, bacon, pepperjack.

name: Turkey Club
steps: Build on sourdough.
Cut before serving.
off: OG — on request. Also on the catering menu

name: Caesar's Lemon Blackout Wrap
ing: 1/2 tbsp, instead of blackening spice when heating
steps: Heat the 12" tortilla in the microwave for 15 seconds.
Heat the diced blackened chicken portion using 1/2 tbsp Lemon Blackout instead of blackening spice.
Mix 3 oz chopped romaine with 1 tbsp parmesan and 1 oz caesar dressing; place in the middle of the tortilla.
Place the heated chicken on the romaine mixture and squeeze one lemon wedge over it.
Fold the wrap like an envelope.
Place 1 tbsp shredded cheese on the flap; grill cheese-side down 30 seconds, flip and repeat.
Cut diagonally and shingle; close with a picked lemon wedge. 6 oz fries on the side.

name: Mugs Chicken Sandwich
ing: 1/2 tbsp bottom bun + 1/2 tbsp top bun
steps: Dress the bottom bun: 1/2 tbsp sriracha ranch, 3 pickles, 1/3 cup shredded lettuce.
Using a brined chicken breast, follow the chicken tender breading process.
Fry 6 minutes; pull and drain the grease in a Sav a Day.
American cheese on the chicken; 1/2 tbsp sriracha ranch on the top bun.
Leave the top bun OFF in the window so the cheese melts - place it on BEFORE taking to the guest.
6 oz fries on the side.

name: Mombo Combo Build
ing: 3 — wedges 3 ea · eggrolls 2 rolls · tenders 3 · pickles/shrooms 4 oz
match sauce to app — 2 oz each
steps: Plate all three on lined burger basket.
If eggrolls are a selection, only cut by request.

name: Seans Nachos
ing: choose: no meat, chopped sirloin (philly puck), diced blackened chicken portion (heated), or 4 oz chili
steps: 6 oz chips in a lined basket; 6 oz rotel.
Protein is chosen at order - no meat, chopped sirloin, diced blackened chicken, or 4 oz chili.
If chili is chosen, the rotel goes ON TOP of the chili.
Add 1/4 cup diced tomatoes and 1/4 cup diced onions.
Finish with a #40 scoop of sour cream and 8 slices of fresh jalapenos.

name: Pow Pow Shrimp Build
steps: Drizzle sriracha on the plate; 1/2 cup salad mix on top.
Using the buttermilk and breader designated for shrimp ONLY, double-bread the thawed shrimp: coat evenly in breader, dip in buttermilk, coat evenly in breader again, shake off any excess.
Fry 3 minutes in the shrimp-designated fryer.
Drain the grease in a Sav A Day.
Toss the fried shrimp in 2 oz Pow Pow sauce.
Place the shrimp on the lettuce mix; finish with a dusting of parsley.

name: Katie's Kickin' Chicken
ing: choose: honey mustard, or tossed in Wang sauce
steps: Hand-breaded and fried chicken tenders.
Served with honey mustard, or have the tenders tossed in Wang sauce.
Served with house-made ranch and beer-battered fries.
Also available grilled or blackened.

name: Chips 'n
storage: Mugshots Squat Cup on Lined Burger Basket
steps: Ladle 6 oz of chosen dip into squat cup.
Serve with basket of chips.

name: Cheese Wedges
storage: Lined Wire Basket on Lined Burger Basket
steps: Fry wedges; basket with 2 oz marinara.

name: Southwest Eggrolls Build
storage: Lined Wire Basket on Lined Burger Basket
ing: 3 rolls, cut in half corner to corner
steps: Fry; cut corner to corner.
To-go: do not cut unless guest requests.

name: Wangs
storage: Lined Wire Basket on Lined Burger Basket
ing: Mild · Hot · BBQ · Teriyaki · Sesame Ginger · Lemon Pepper · Carolina Gold · Honey Hot · Sweet Chili · Mango Habanero · Garlic Parm
steps: Fry and toss in sauce.
1 ranch + 2 celery per 5 wings.

name: Chicken Basket
ing: 6 — knuckled, double battered, fried or grilled
Mild · Hot · BBQ · Teriyaki · Sesame Ginger · Lemon Pepper · Carolina Gold · Honey Hot · Sweet Chili · Mango Habanero · Garlic Parm
steps: Knuckle the tenders, double batter and fry — or grill.
Toss in the chosen sauce.
Lined burger basket with 6 oz fries; 2 oz dipping sauce on the side.
3 tenders to a Mombo.

name: Davis’ Dill Pickles
storage: Lined Wire Basket on Lined Burger Basket
steps: Batter and fry 8 oz pickles.
Serve with 2 oz comeback.

name: Shrooms Build
storage: Lined Wire Basket on Lined Burger Basket
steps: Batter and fry 8 oz mushrooms.
Serve with 2 oz ranch.

name: Chili Build
storage: Squat Cup on Red Saucer or Blue Bowl on Red Plate
steps: Ladle chili; top with cheese and onions.
To-go: Mugs cups + crackers in to-go box.

name: BBQ Nachos
steps: 6 oz chips in a lined basket; 6 oz rotel.
Diced blackened chicken portion, heated, then 6 zig zags of BBQ.
Add 1/4 cup diced tomatoes and 1/4 cup diced onions.
Finish with a #40 scoop of sour cream and 8 slices of fresh jalapenos.

name: Chuck's Clucks
yields: 6 oz · 3 oz on Mombo / Happy Hour
ing: 6 oz, double-battered and fried (3 oz on Mombo or Happy Hour)
tossed — choice of: mild, hot, Nashville hot, honey hot, BBQ, teriyaki, sweet chili, Carolina gold, garlic parmesan, lemon pepper, lemon blackout
steps: Double-batter 6 oz chicken chunks and fry. On a Mombo or Happy Hour order the portion is 3 oz.
Toss in the guest’s choice of sauce: mild, hot, Nashville hot, honey hot, BBQ, teriyaki, sweet chili, Carolina gold, garlic parmesan, lemon pepper, lemon blackout.
Plate in a lined small bowl.
Serve with 2 oz ranch and 2 celery pieces on the side.

name: She-E-O
steps: Mayo + lettuce on bottom bun.
Patty, waffle fries, cheese sauce, diced tomatoes & red onions.

name: Guthrie's Godfather
steps: Garlic mayo on bottom bun.
Patty, mozz wedges, marinara, pesto on bun.

name: Breakfast Burger
steps: Dress bottom bun.
Patty, bacon, american, fried egg on top.

name: Quesadilla
steps: Cheese side down on flat top, 30 sec each side.
To-go: diced tomatoes & red onions on quesadilla, sriracha mayo in 2 oz ramekin.
off: OG — on request. No pico: diced tomatoes & red onions

name: Rajun Cajun Salad
steps: 6 oz salad mix in a large salad bowl.
Build with 1/4 cup diced tomatoes, 1/8 cup diced red onions, 1/2 cup shredded cheese.
Diced blackened chicken portion, heated, on top.
Finish with Tony Chachere's and parsley; two 2 oz ranch on the side.

name: Buffalo Bleu Salad
steps: Toss strips in mild; cut and place on greens.
Bleu cheese and parsley on top.

name: Cheeseburger Bowl
shelf: 4 oz salad mix + 1 oz shredded lettuce
ing: 7 oz, seasoned with Tony's, chopped like ground beef
2 oz, drizzled on beef + combined on flat top
steps: Toss 4 oz salad mix and 1 oz shredded lettuce with 1 oz comeback sauce.
Season 7 oz patty with Tony's, cook on flat top, chop small like ground beef.
Drizzle 2 oz queso over the beef and combine on the flat top.
Top with pickles, waffle fries, shredded cheese, diced tomatoes, diced onions and chopped bacon.

name: Teriyaki Bowl
shelf: 4 oz salad mix + 3 oz asian slaw
steps: Build greens and slaw.
Cut tenders bite-size; drizzle teriyaki across bowl.

name: Side House Salad
steps: Build and top with croutons.
Side salads get 1 dressing on the side.

name: Caesar Salad
ing: 10 — or 5 oz blackened chicken tender portion, heated
steps: Toss 5 oz chopped romaine with 4 oz caesar dressing and 1/2 cup croutons.
Plate in a large salad bowl.
Top with the chosen protein: 10 blackened shrimp, or a 5 oz blackened chicken tender portion, heated.
Garnish with 1 oz parmesan cheese.

name: Side Caesar Salad
steps: Toss 3 oz chopped romaine with 2 oz caesar dressing and 1/4 cup croutons.
Plate in a small salad bowl.
Garnish with 1 oz parmesan cheese.
No protein on the side salad.

name: Cajun Pasta
steps: Toss 7 oz penne with 4 oz alfredo and 1/4 cup diced tomatoes.
Diced blackened chicken portion, heated, on top.
Finish with Tony Chachere's and parsley.
Sliced toasted sourdough on edge of bowl.
Protein is chosen: blackened, grilled or fried chicken; blackened shrimp; chopped sirloin steak.

name: Parm Pasta
steps: Toss penne with alfredo; marinara over.
Cut strips on top; parm + parsley; toast on edge.

name: Blackened Shrimp Pasta
steps: Toss 7 oz penne with 4 oz alfredo and 1/4 cup diced tomatoes.
10 blackened shrimp on top — thawed 3 min, frozen 3 1/2 to 4 min.
Finish with 1 oz parmesan and parsley.
Sliced toasted sourdough on edge of bowl.

name: Philly Pasta
ing: w/ 1 oz bell peppers + 1 oz onions, flat top
steps: Cook philly set on flat top.
Toss with pasta & cheese sauce BEFORE plating.
off: Off the menu — the pastas are combined, see Cajun Pasta

name: Hamburger Steak Plate
steps: Seasoned Mugs burger patty.
Top the patty with 2 oz sautéed mushrooms and 2 oz gravy.
Mashed potatoes with 2 oz gravy on top, plus grilled veggies.
Toasted sliced sourdough on the side, cut corner to corner.

name: Blackened Mahi Plate
steps: Blackened mahi with grilled veggies.
Mahi plate only has ONE side.

name: Bishop Burger
ing: standard Middleberger build — any burger except Mac-N-Cheese or Steak Burger
steps: Build like a mini Middleberger unless requested otherwise.

name: Kayla's Mini Chicken Basket
ing: 3 — knuckled, double battered, fried or grilled
steps: Fry or grill 3 tenders; basket with fries.

name: Emma's Grilled Cheese
steps: Grill; cut in half; pickle slice on each half.

name: Hailey's Egg Sandwich
steps: Fried egg on kid bun.

name: Meg's Mac-N-Cheese
storage: Squat Cup on Burger Basket w/ Liner
steps: Scoop mac into squat cup.
Optional chopped tender on top.

name: Peanut Butter-N-Jelly
steps: PB on one slice, jelly on the other.
Do NOT grill; cut in half.

name: Taylor's Mini Pasta
ing: choice of alfredo or marinara, tossed
optional, grilled or fried, on top
steps: Toss pasta in chosen sauce.
Serve on the liner (Tay’s Pasta).

name: Duncan's Quesadilla
steps: Cut tortilla in half; cheese on tortilla on flat top ~1.5 min; fold.
30 sec each side; cut in equal halves and shingle at the point.

name: Dessert Nachos
steps: Fry, drain, toss in cinnamon sugar.
Scoop of ice cream + both drizzles on top.
To-go: sauces 2 oz each, scoop on side.

name: Bread Puddin' Bites
steps: Fry 2 minutes; toss in cinnamon sugar.

name: Root Beer Float
steps: Root beer in frosted mug; ice cream on top.
To-go: cup 3/4 full, scoop on the side.

name: Sriracha Ranch
steps: Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and whisk together.
Scrape into a 1/6 pan with a rubber spatula and cover.
Label and place in cooler until needed.

name: Sliced Jalapeños
steps: Rinse whole fresh jalapenos and allow to dry to prevent slipping.
Slice across into 1/4" rounds (width of a pencil); discard the stem cap.
Place in shallow 1/6 pan and cover with water; lid on pan.
Label and place in cooler until needed.
On the line, keep the slices covered in water so they do not dry out. Do not over prep.

name: Queso Portions
steps: Heat flat top to 375°.
Cook patties, seasoning with Tony's while breaking apart; cook through.
Strain to fully drain grease; cool to 40°.
Weigh 2 oz portions into 3.25 portion cups; add 2 tsp pickled jalapeño juice each; lid.
Place in shallow 1/4 pan; label and date; cooler.

name: Brined Chicken Tenders
steps: In a 22 qt Cambro: water, salt, sugar; whisk until dissolved.
Add tenders; cover, label; walk-in.
Brine 12–14 hours.
Drain fully (drip lexan or colander).
Deep 1/3 pan with drip insert; cover, label; cooler.

name: Blackened Chicken Tenders
steps: Whisk butter + blackening spice until NOT lumpy.
Coat brined tenders thoroughly in a 1/2 pan; cover; marinate in walk-in.
Cook on heated flat top to 165° internal.
Cool fully on sheet tray with cling wrap.
Cut each tender into 6 cubes (once lengthwise, twice across).
Portion 5 oz; label; cooler.

name: Brined Chicken Breast
steps: In an 8 qt Cambro: water, salt, sugar; whisk until dissolved.
Pound 10 breasts and add to brine; cover, label; walk-in.
Brine 8–12 hours.
Drain fully in colander.
Deep 1/3 pan with drip insert; cover, label; cooler.

name: Blackened Chicken Breast
steps: Whisk butter + seasoning in large stainless bowl until well blended.
Add brined breasts, coating well.
Place in 1/2 pan, cover; day dot; cooler.

name: Monster Cookie Prep
steps: Divide the cookie into 4 quarters.
Finely chop one quarter into coarse ground crumbles.
Place the crumbled 1/4 cookie into 2 oz ramekin and top with lid — one cookie = 2 crumble portions.
Individually wrap the remaining quarters in plastic wrap (used for garnish); place on top of portioned crumbles in a deep 1/4 pan.
Label and date container; place in cooler until ready to use.

name: Mugs Signature Sauce
steps: Charred jalapeños: cut tops off, remove seeds; char on flat top under burger press ~10 min, turning for even blistering; cool slightly, finely mince.
Whisk mayo + mustard in a large stainless bowl until fully smooth.
Add remaining ingredients (incl. minced jalapeños); whisk until thoroughly incorporated.
Pour into third pan with spatula; cover, label, and store.
Quality: light orange-red with visible jalapeño specks; smooth and creamy.

name: 10 oz Mugshots Milkshake
steps: Add half & half and any flavoring to mixing tin.
Add 2 – #8 scoops vanilla ice cream.
Blend on shake mixer until no lumps.
Pour into frosted 10 oz mug; top with whipped cream and a cherry.
Monster Cookie shake: garnish with a cookie quarter.
Serve with jumbo straw.

name: 22 oz Mugshots Milkshake
steps: Add half & half and any flavoring to mixing tin.
Add 4 – #8 scoops vanilla ice cream.
Blend on shake mixer until no lumps.
Pour into frosted 22 oz mug; top with whipped cream and a cherry.
Monster Cookie shake: garnish with a cookie quarter.
Serve with jumbo straw.

name: Colony Wangs
steps: Fry wings; serve naked or tossed in 2 oz mild or hot — other sauces also available.
Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Firecracker Boneless Wangs
steps: Bread chicken chunks: breader, buttermilk, breader.
Fry 3 minutes; pull and drain in Sav-a-Day.
Serve naked or tossed in 2 oz sauce; ranch + celery on side.

name: Firecracker Wedges
steps: Fry wedges golden.
Serve in small bowl with liner, 2 oz marinara on side.

name: New Cajun Salad
steps: Base of salad mix; add onions, tomatoes, cheese.
Top with fried boneless wangs and croutons.
Serve with 2 oz ranch on the side.

name: Single Classic Smash
ing: 1/2 Tbsp bottom bun + 1/2 Tbsp top bun
steps: Dress bottom bun: signature sauce, sautéed onions, pickles.
Single smash patty topped with American cheese.
Finish top bun with 1/2 Tbsp signature sauce. Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Savell SmashBurger
steps: Place 1 slice cheddar on one patty.
Place 2 slices bacon and 1 slice cheddar on the other patty.
Place patty with bacon on top of the other patty.
Squirt a little water NEXT TO the patties and cover both with dome ~10–15 seconds.
Remove from flat top and place on dressed bottom bun.
Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: McDowell SmashBurger
steps: Place 1 slice cheddar on one patty.
Place 1 tbsp BBQ, 2 slices bacon, & 1 slice cheddar on the other patty.
Place patty with bacon on top of the other patty.
Squirt a little water NEXT TO the patties and cover both with dome ~10–15 seconds.
Remove from flat top and place on dressed bottom bun.
Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Texan SmashBurger
steps: Place 1 slice pepperjack on one patty.
Place 1 slice pepperjack on the other patty.
Place one patty on top of the other patty.
Squirt a little water NEXT TO the patties and cover both with dome ~10–15 seconds.
Remove from flat top and place on dressed bottom bun.
Top with fried onion strings + fried jalapeños. Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Southern SmashBurger
steps: Place 1/2 pimento cheese portion on one patty.
Place 2 slices bacon & 1/2 pimento cheese portion on the other patty.
Place patty with bacon on top of the other patty.
Squirt a little water NEXT TO the patties and cover both with dome ~10–15 seconds.
Remove from flat top and place on dressed bottom bun.
Top with fried pickles. Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Signature SmashBurger
steps: Place 2 slices bacon and 1 slice American cheese on one patty.
Place 1 slice American cheese on the other patty.
Place patty with bacon on top of the other patty.
Squirt a little water NEXT TO the patties and cover both with dome ~8–10 seconds.
Remove from flat top and place on dressed bottom bun.
Finish with 1/2 tbsp Mugs Signature Sauce on top. Serve with 6 oz fries.

name: Cheeseburger Quesadilla
steps: Heat 1 portion quesadilla meat on the flat top.
Place tortilla on the flat top; sprinkle 1/2 cup shredded mixed cheese on one half.
Place the heated meat on the cheese; fold the plain half over it.
Heat ~30 seconds, flip, heat 30 seconds, remove.
Cut in equal quarters. Lay 1/3 cup shredded lettuce on the lined basket and shingle the quarters at the point on top of it.
Drizzle 2 oz sriracha mayo side-to-side; sprinkle 1 oz diced tomatoes & red onions on top.

name: Sweet Tater Philly Nachos
steps: Cook waffle sweet potato fries 2 1/2 minutes; drain and hold in a sav-a-day.
Cook 1 philly steak puck with 1 oz diced red onions and 1 oz diced bell peppers on the flat top.
Place the philly mixture on the cooked sweet potato fries.
Top with 2 oz Mugs queso, a side-to-side drizzle of 2 oz sriracha mayo, and 1 oz diced tomatoes & red onions.
TO GO: large ToGo box, philly on the fries; queso, sriracha mayo and diced tomatoes & red onions in covered ramekins alongside.

name: Philly Steak Eggrolls
storage: Lined Burger Basket with Lined Wire Basket
steps: Cook 4 minutes; drain on a Sav-A-Day.
Cut on the bias and place cut side facing up.
2 oz comeback sauce on the side.
TO GO: do not cut the eggrolls unless the guest asks.

name: Sweet Potato Cheesecake
steps: Plate one slice of cheesecake on a black pow pow plate.
Caramel drizzle over the top.
TO GO: lined black ToGo box; 2 oz caramel in a covered ramekin alongside.

name: Cheesecake
steps: Place one slice of cheesecake on a black pow pow plate.
Place one pick at each end of the slice.
Wrap the plated slice in plastic wrap; date and hold on a sheet pan in the cooler.

name: Wangs - New Flavors
storage: Lined Wire Basket on Lined Burger Basket
steps: Portion wangs.
Sauce, based on 5 wangs — Pepper Jelly: toss in 2 oz pepper jelly wang sauce. Honey Peach Glaze: same as the current wing recipe. Spicy Lemon Dry Rub: toss in 1 TBSP.
2 pieces celery and 1 ramekin ranch per 5 wangs.

name: Honey Peach Fried Chicken Salad
ing: 3, tossed in Sweet Baby Rays Honey Peach
steps: Place 6 oz salad mix in the bowl.
Top with shredded mozzarella and pineapple salsa.
Toss 3 fried tenders in Sweet Baby Rays honey peach wing sauce, chop, and add.
2 x 2 oz ramekins of spicy peach salad dressing on the side.

name: Summer Double Stack
shelf: Summer 2025 LTO — carried to Fall 2025 as Classic Double Stack
steps: Bottom bun: 1 TBSP ranch dressing and 1 TBSP sauteed onions.
Kid burger topped with a slice of American cheese.
Second kid burger topped with 2 slices bacon and a slice of American cheese.
1/4 cup fried jals, then the top bun.
6 oz french fries.

name: Sweet McB
steps: FRIED BUN: coat all sides of a Mugshots bun with liquid egg or egg wash. Put the fryer basket in the fryer BEFORE the bun.
Fry sliced-side up 20 seconds; turn with tongs, press with the basket press, fry 1 minute.
Remove and dust both sides with cinnamon sugar; pass to grill setup.
Build: bottom bun, grilled Mugs burger, 2 slices bacon, American cheese, top bun.
Sprinkle powdered sugar. 6 oz sweet potato waffle fries and 2 oz maple syrup.

name: Mahi Tacos
steps: Cook the mahi on the flat top in a slurry of 1 oz liquid butter and 2 TBSP blackening spice, tossing to coat.
Warm 2 flour tortillas on the flat top 20 seconds; remove.
1/4 cup asian slaw in each tortilla; divide the mahi between them.
Top with 1/4 cup pineapple salsa; drizzle 1 oz sriracha mayo on each.
Taco stand on a lined basket. 3 oz ramekin salsa and 2 oz tortilla chips.

name: Smokey Bourbon Maple Stack
steps: Bottom bun: 1 TBSP garlic aioli and 1/4 cup spring mix.
Kid burger topped with a slice of cheddar, melted.
Second kid burger topped with 1 oz smokey maple bourbon sauce, 2 slices bacon and a slice of cheddar, melted.
2 oz sauteed red onions, then the top bun.
6 oz french fries.

name: Pretzel Basket
steps: Fry the pretzel sticks 60–90 seconds; drain in a Sav-A-Day.
Brush each pretzel evenly with liquid butter (butter alternative) using a pastry brush.
Coat each stick evenly with kosher salt from a shaker.
Lined wire basket with 5 oz rotel in a Mugs squat cup.

name: Chili Trio
steps: Cup of chili topped with 1 oz shredded cheese and 1 tbsp diced red onion.
Guest chooses ONE: Bishop Burger (middle — others available for an upcharge); (5) wangs tossed in a choice of sauce; or (3) chicken tenders tossed in a choice of sauce, fried or grilled on request.
If wangs or tenders are chosen, add 2 oz dipping sauce.
4 oz fries on the side.

name: Nashville Hot Tacos
steps: Warm 3 flour tortillas on the flat top 15–20 seconds each side; place in a taco stand.
In each tortilla: 1/4 cup shredded lettuce, one tender tossed in Nashville Hot, 1 Tbsp diced dill pickles.
Drizzle each taco with a zig-zag of ranch dressing.
2 oz ramekin salsa and 2 oz tortilla chips.

name: Don't Be Jelly Double Stack
shelf: Fall 2025 LTO — carried over from Summer 2025
steps: Bottom bun: 1 TBSP pepper jelly.
Kid burger topped with 1/2 portion pimento cheese.
Second kid burger topped with 2 slices bacon and 1/2 portion pimento cheese.
1/4 cup fried pickles, then the top bun.
6 oz french fries.

name: Classic Double Stack
shelf: Fall 2025 LTO — the Summer 2025 Summer Double Stack, renamed
steps: Bottom bun: 1 TBSP ranch dressing and 1 TBSP sauteed onions.
Kid burger topped with a slice of American cheese.
Second kid burger topped with 2 slices bacon and a slice of American cheese.
1/4 cup fried jals, then the top bun.
6 oz french fries.

name: Bulleit Rye Old-Fashioned
steps: Add 2 bar spoons simple syrup, 2 dashes of each bitters and 2 oz Bulleit Rye to a rocks glass.
Add ice. Stir gently until the ice and the liquid equalize.
Zest an orange peel over the glass, then drop the peel in with a cherry.

name: Sweet Heat Margarita
shelf: Jan 2026 drink menu · began as a Fall 2025 special
steps: Add ice and the infused tequila, Cointreau, puree and sweet 'n sour.
Shake vigorously ~30 seconds.
Pour into a 16 oz pint glass with a sugar rim.
Garnish with sliced fresh jalapeños.

name: Smokey Bourbon Sauce
steps: Place all ingredients in a stainless mixing bowl.
Whisk together until fully mixed.
Pour into a squeeze bottle for the line; label and date.
Excess into a 1/6 pan; label, date, cooler.

name: Jalapeño Infused Tequila
steps: Spray the charbroiler with non-stick spray.
Grill 8–10 fresh jalapeños per bottle for 8–10 minutes, until slightly charred all around.
Pour the Lunazul into a cambro big enough for the batch; add the whole charred jalapeños.
Cover, date, and infuse in the cooler for 72 hours.
Strain the jalapeños out; funnel into store 'n pours. Label and keep refrigerated.

name: 'Mug'arita
steps: In a mixing tin combine 1.25 oz Lunazul Blanco, .5 oz Cointreau and 7 oz sour mix.
Shake and pour into a 22 oz mug with a salted rim; fill with ice.
Float .5 oz Grand Marnier. Garnish with a lime wedge and orange slice.

name: Strawberry 'Mug'arita
steps: In a mixing tin combine 1.25 oz Lunazul Blanco, .5 oz Cointreau, 1.5 oz daiquiri mix and 5 oz sour mix.
Shake and pour into a 22 oz mug with a sugar rim; fill with ice.
Float 2 oz sliced strawberries and .5 oz Grand Marnier. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Espresso Martini
steps: Scoop of ice into a mixing tin; add the HooDoo Espresso.
Add Bailey's or DiSaronno if requested.
Cap and shake vigorously ~30 seconds.
Strain into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with 4 coffee beans.

name: Red Bull Tropical Cooler
steps: Fill a 16 oz pint glass with ice; add the Cathead mandarin vodka.
Top with Red Bull Tropical. DO NOT shake.
Garnish with an orange wedge. Serve the rest of the Red Bull alongside.

name: 'Sippers Cherry Limeade
steps: Fill a 16 oz pint glass with ice; add the vodka and cherry juice.
Squeeze 2 lime wedges over the ice and drop them in.
Top with Sprite. DO NOT shake — stir with a bar spoon.
Garnish with a cherry and a lime wedge.

name: Pama-Rita
steps: Add ice and the tequila, Cointreau, Pama and sweet 'n sour.
Shake vigorously ~30 seconds.
Pour into a 16 oz pint glass with a sugar rim. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Mango-Lime Spritzer
steps: Fill a 16 oz pint glass with ice; squeeze half a lime over it.
Top with mango puree and ginger beer.
Stir with a bar spoon. DO NOT shake. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Sparkling Cranberry Quincher
steps: Fill a 16 oz pint glass with ice.
Add cranberry juice, agave nectar and Topo Chico.
Stir with a bar spoon. DO NOT shake. Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Mugshots Strawberry Lemonade
steps: In a mixing tin add 1.5 oz strawberry daiquiri mix and 8 oz lemonade.
Shake and pour into a 22 oz mug; fill with ice.
FROM BULK: shake the jug and pour into an ice-filled 22 oz mug.
Garnish with a float of 2 oz sliced strawberries and a lemon wedge.

name: Mugs Strawberry Lemonade Bulk
steps: Add both to a gallon jug.
Lid on; shake thoroughly until well mixed.
Store in the refrigerated cooler.

name: Simple Syrup
steps: Bring 3 cups water to a boil.
Reduce heat and add 3 cups sugar; stir continuously until fully dissolved.
Remove from heat and let cool.
Pour into a cambro and cover; store in the cooler.
